files.note: Transaction/record logic (mod.rs) is written once against the IdbBackend/IdbTransaction traits. memory.rs is a host IndexedDB model (key ordering, compound indexes, snapshot+creation-order transactions, atomic readwrite); web.rs binds web-sys IndexedDB (wasm32, feature `indexeddb`). Store/index names, key paths and row shapes are the upstream on-disk format, verified against reference-written rows. pi-durable builds for wasm32-unknown-unknown (`cargo check -p pi-durable --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features indexeddb`; layout documented in crates/pi-durable/Cargo.toml): only tools, images, the native env and native SQLite are native-only (OS access); the harness, scheduler, code mode and pi-ai (reqwest fetch backend) build there too, and the browser suite runs with all of them linked in. tests/indexeddb_browser/run.sh builds a cdylib from the crate itself and runs, in headless Chrome 155: the reference conformance traces against IndexedDbStorage<WebIdbConnection> (26 plain + 26 across reopen, all pass), 2297 browser-vs-host-model differential scans/gets, transaction semantics, and row interchange both ways with the reference. IndexedDbStorageOptions.indexedDB maps to WebIdbFactory::new(factory); open/delete map to IndexedDbStorage::{open,open_with,delete} (wasm32 only). Runtime on wasm32: tasks and timers go through pi_chord::rt / pi_ai::utils::wasm (microtask queue, setTimeout, JS clock; tokio re-exports natively), enforced by tests/wasm32_gate/check.sh (wasm32 clippy with disallowed-methods). The browser suite also runs a Session (concurrent commits, reopen) and a full Harness turn with the faux provider (tool call, timer-paced stream, durable receipt, close/reopen transcript) over IndexedDbStorage in headless Chrome. The same faux Harness turn runs in workerd over Durable Object SQLite with an eviction between submit and resume (tests/workerd/harness.test.ts); a browser regression asserts that dropped wasm sleeps clear their setTimeout (an armed timer blocked Durable Object eviction).

files.note: All 56 upstream cases (26 conformance cases in each of 2 registrations, plus 4 standalone) ported and passing on the host IndexedDB model, which stands in for fake-indexeddb. The 52 conformance cases also pass in headless Chrome against real IndexedDB through the crate (tests/indexeddb_browser/run.sh; not part of cargo test, needs Chrome and playwright-core). Fixtures are recorded from the unmodified reference IndexedDbStorage over fake-indexeddb 6.2.5 (upstream pins 6.2.6) by fixtures/indexeddb/generate.mjs; `--check` reproduces them byte-for-byte.
